messages:
samir (eng-sre): Heads up — we've been getting a burst of noisy SLO alerts for /v1/generate from 02:00–04:00 UTC. Console shows ~120% of baseline alert volume for that route.

maria (eng-platform): ugh. do we have a recent config change or rollout?

samir (eng-sre): No changes on serving yesterday. It looks correlated with a tenant traffic spike plus a change in seq length distribution. Alerts are P2s but flooding ops channels.

anne (serving): I can confirm a handful of tenants increased max_seq this morning. Could be more KV cache misses -> higher error ratio in short windows.

jess (devex): Quick question — are these firing from the per-route SLO rules or from a derived global SLO aggregation?

samir (eng-sre): Mostly per-route. Example rule (PromQL-ish):

```
alert: SLOViolation_HighRate_generate
expr: increase(slo_errors_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m]) / increase(slo_requests_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m]) > 0.03
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: p2
  owner: serving
annotations:
  summary: "High error rate for /v1/generate"
  runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-generate"
```

samir (eng-sre): The short window + single-tenant spikes means we surface too many alerts to the org-wide notify tier.

maria (eng-platform): Two vectors here: 1) console UX — let teams opt to "hide noisy tenants" or collapse per-tenant alerts in the SLO view; 2) routing/policy — add a cheap noise-suppression layer before fanout.

tony (product): From a UX POV we should avoid hiding signals by default. Maybe default to collapse + a quick expand to see offending tenants. Show confidence/impact numbers.

jess (devex): Agree. Also add a little CTA in the collapsed view: "Mute tenant X in this SLO for 1h" so operators can triage without creating a silence in PagerDuty.

anne (serving): On policy side we can add a pre-fanout filter that does: dedupe by tenant fingerprint, require 2 distinct 5m buckets > threshold, and drop alerts under 1% global impact. That would reduce noise for bursty low-impact tenants.

samir (eng-sre): Proposed quick mitigation:
- Add a short debounce: require sustained violation across two adjacent 5m windows (configurable)
- Add impact threshold: only escalate to org notify if estimated token-loss > threshold OR tenant not in quiet-mode
- Mark suppressed alerts in console with reason so teams can still discover them

maria (eng-platform): Implementation plan: we add a middleware in notify-service to compute: fingerprint, impact_estimate, sustained_count. If impact_estimate < 1% -> route to tenant channel only (no org fanout). Otherwise full fanout. We'll expose a toggle in console per-SLO.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: notify-service/noise-filter v0.1 -> canary on staging at 2026-03-25T09:00Z; rollout to prod 10% routes after smoke.

tony (product): Nice. Can we get a console prototype that shows collapsed tenants + a per-tenant "why suppressed" tooltip? Jess, can you sketch?

jess (devex): Yep. I'll put a tiny prototype in Figma and drop link here by EOD. It will include copy for the suppression reasons and an inline "escalate anyway" button.

maria (eng-platform): Telemetry: add two new metrics: suppressed_alerts_total{reason="impact"|"debounce"}, suppressed_alerts_routed_to_tenant. Also tag SLO alerts with tenant_id, route, and model_variant for later QoE analysis.

anne (serving): We should also emit a trace/span for the suppression decision so debug is easy in distributed trace.

samir (eng-sre): Action items:
- anne: implement notify-service filter + trace (PR by Fri)
- jess: Figma prototype + CTA copy (EOD)
- maria: console API for suppression toggle + collapsed UI contract (PR next Wed)
- tony: confirm policy defaults (impact threshold = 1%?)
- samir: prepare canary test plan and synthetic traffic to validate suppression doesn't drop real incidents

tony (product): I'm ok with 1% default. Ops teams can opt lower.

samir (eng-sre): ok let's proceed. If anyone sees urgent regressions ping me. Thanks. :thumbsup:

maria (eng-platform): I'll add a short changelog entry in the console release notes and a help doc about suppression semantics.

ops-bot: CI: pipeline passed for notify-service/noise-filter v0.1 (build 482).

samir (eng-sre): Moving this into the rollout checklist. Will update thread with canary results.

maria (eng-platform): +1. Good plan.
